_comment: SN22's deployment settings. Read by kata-subnets-deploy's installer, which validates every
value against its allowlist and ceilings before rendering any unit. This file may set only
what a subnet decides for itself: challenge sizing, its own budget caps, and round timing.
Lane identity, source repo, plugin path, entry point, writable paths and public visibility are
the registry's; naming one here is refused outright, not ignored.
subnet_id and lane_id below are an ASSERTION, not an input: they are checked against the
registry lane so pointing the generator at the wrong checkout fails loudly.
The daily caps cover ten worst-case paired challenges. Candidate inference is miner-funded;
the validator reserves only room runs and independently metered verification resources.
A spend_usd cap is intentionally absent because these providers expose no hard per-request
price ceiling here; pretending to enforce one would be weaker than enforcing billed units.
KATA_PROMOTE_MARGINS is GONE from the production path as of Phase G. It was the indifference
band for the seven-signal lexicographic comparator, which production no longer uses: a duel is
decided on one number, sn22_combined_score, produced by the pinned upstream's own
combine_pool_scores over both contestants' four pool tuples. A margin on that would be Kata
overriding upstream's own arithmetic about what counts as better. A tie keeps the King, and
strictly greater promotes. The value below is retained ONLY for the local calibration sandbox,
which still ranks on the seven signals until its scorer is replaced.
